prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1149; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from my right ran its red light and struck the side of my car. The impact spun my vehicle partway around and pushed it toward the curb. I was held in place by my seatbelt, and the airbags deployed. After the collision I felt sharp pain in my left wrist and could not grip the steering wheel. Paramedics took me to the hospital, where X-rays showed a fracture in my wrist. Looking back, I recall a few more details about the moments before impact than I did at the scene, but the core sequence has stayed the same each time I have described it. I am the named driver on this policy and I am providing this account for the claim.
